scope: Interview candidate detail UI from user screenshot, inspected with nhandt02 on TEST. Existing interview/candidate records were read only.
finding: A fixed-layout table had no widths on six data columns. At narrow viewports these shared the remaining width after index/actions, truncating headers and splitting badge text vertically.
changes: Set widths for name, birth date, phone, email, time and status; minimum table width 1140px inside its existing scroll region.
Keep status on one line and retain sticky actions, paginator and mobile filter controls.
Add mobile swipe hint and wrap long interview title/interviewer text.
